Q5731.reason: The brother’s interest is measured by the uncle’s life and, on the uncle’s move, divests the uncle’s vested life estate, so it is a shifting executory interest pur autre vie rather than a remainder or a present estate.

Q5115.reason: Lactate is made from pyruvate, and activating glycolysis at exercise onset raises pyruvate and NADH faster than mitochondria clear them, so LDH produces more lactate.

Q5932.reason: Repeated high-intensity bouts drive catecholamine-stimulated hepatic glucose output above muscle uptake, so blood glucose commonly rises about 1–3 mM over 80–90 minutes.
